title: Read, Then Shade? How Visual Evidence Changes Incentive-Driven Misreporting in Vision-Language Advisors
abstract: arXiv:2611.19561v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly read a scene and report it to someone who acts on the report, sometimes under objectives that differ from that person's. We ask whether a stated incentive moves what a VLM reports, and whether this changes when the value must be read from pixels rather than given as text. In seeded synthetic scenes, a model reads the position of a target on a labelled axis and reports one integer to a fixed receiver; it is paid, in simulation, for accuracy or for a report a few units to one side, and every scene is also presented with the true value as text. Across a pilot and three follow-up studies with hash-frozen protocols, four small open VLMs from three families, and 15,170 held-out trials, a stated payoff moved reports in both modalities, and exact compliance at three units was significantly lower with the image than with text for three of four models; Qwen2.5-VL 7B showed no reliable difference. translated_title: 先读后偏？视觉证据如何改变视觉语言顾问中由激励驱动的误报
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型越来越多地读取场景并将结果报告给依据该报告采取行动的人，而模型自身的目标有时与后者并不一致。我们探究明确的激励是否会改变VLM所报告的内容，以及当该数值必须从像素中读取而非以文本形式给出时，这种行为是否会发生变化。在固定随机种子的合成场景中，模型读取标注坐标轴上目标的位置，并向固定的接收者报告一个整数；在模拟中，它或因报告准确获得报酬，或因报告偏向某一侧若干单位而获得报酬，且每个场景还同时以文本形式提供真实值。通过一项试点研究与三项采用哈希冻结协议的后续研究，涵盖来自三个系列的四个小型开源VLM以及15,170个保留测试样本，结果表明：明确的报酬在两种模态下均会使报告发生偏移，且四个模型中有三个在图像条件下的三单位精确服从率显著低于文本条件；Qwen2.5-VL 7B则未表现出可靠差异。（原文摘要此处截断）
tldr: 该研究发现明确的激励会驱使视觉语言模型在报告中偏离真实值，但当信息需要从图像像素中读取而非以文本形式给出时，模型对激励的精确服从程度显著降低，表明视觉证据能削弱激励驱动的误报行为。
en_tdlr: Stated incentives shift VLM reports in both modalities, but exact compliance is significantly lower when the value must be read from pixels rather than given as text, showing that visual evidence dampens incentive-driven misreporting in vision-language models.
